main_text.head: I. MEDIATOR Foederis Evangelici Hebraice frequenter מָשִׁיחַ appellatur; h. e. Unctus: à rad. מָשַׁח, utpote peculiari quadam ratione præ consortibus suis unctus; Psal. 45. 8. & à Patre suo, ad negotium salutis nobis impetrandæ & applicandæ unicè designatus. Act. 4. 12. Cæteroquin nomen illud laxiore significatu aliis etiam commune est: ut 1 Sam. 24. 7. 2, 1, 21. Psal. 105. 15. In N. T. Μεσσίας dicitur; quod Græcè redditur nomine idem significante, Χριστὸς, à verbo χρίω, Ungo; Joh. 1. 41. 4, IV, 25.

page.notes: Top-left page number "476" and running title read as printed. Greek and Hebrew words in the first section are approximated where the scan is small; the Hebrew for Messias and the Greek of Χριστὸς/χρίω are doubtful. The catchword "De" at the foot is a partial reading. Marginal references in the scan are printed inline in the text and copied as they appear.
